claims.reason: The copied replay reproduces the sealed evidence exactly. An independent root-conditioned formula check confirms the polynomial vectors, terminal zero-extended first descent, both eligibility guards, all identical endpoint selector values, each distinct original support-tagged summand, and all 222 complete sums. The proposed first-descent bound and all-m selector transfer remain unproved, including the non-star lead's disjoint-image step.
